Enable face authentication to automatica: Kunna tantance fuska don buɗe keyring ɗin shiga naka ko KWallet ta atomatik lokacin shiga. We're done! Ubuntu Hello is now active o:
Mun gama! Ubuntu Hello yanzu yana aiki akan wannan kwamfutar. Gwada yin duk wani abu da za ku saba rubuta kalmar sirri don tabbatarwa, kamar gudanar da umarni tare da sudo. Idan kun kunna maɓalli ta atomatik, za a buɗe maɓallin shiga ko KWallet ta atomatik lokacin shiga.

Kuna iya buɗe Ubuntu Hello Configurator daga baya don canza ƙarin saitunan ci gaba ko ƙara ƙarin ƙira. Danna Finish a ƙasa don rufe wannan taga kuma buɗe Ubuntu Hello Configurator.

The most forgiving match and the quickes: Wannan shi ne daidaito mafi sassauci kuma mafi saurin shigar da kai. Zaɓi wannan idan sauƙi ya fi muhimmanci a gare ka fiye da tsauri.

The strictest match, with no extra step: Daidaito mafi tsauri, ba tare da ƙarin mataki ba yayin shiga. An ba da shawarar wannan.
